azkar.translation: Glory and praise be to Allah.

azkar.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
azkar.transliteration: la ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir
azkar.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is capable of all things.
All praise is due to Allah.
I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him.

azkar.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
azkar.translation: Glory be to Allah, all praise is due to Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.

azkar.text: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
azkar.transliteration: la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
azkar.translation: There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

azkar.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
azkar.translation: Glory and praise be to Allah; glory be to Allah, the Magnificent.
O Allah, make it beneficial rain.
We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.
O Allah, make it pleasant and beneficial rain.

azkar.text: تَقُولُ مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ، إِلَّا فِي الْحَيَّعَلَتَيْنِ، فَتَقُولُ: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
azkar.transliteration: taqulu mithla ma yaqulul-muadhdhin, illa fil-hayy alatayn, fataqulu la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
azkar.translation: Repeat what the caller to prayer says, except when he says Come to prayer and Come to success; then say: There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma rabba hadhihid-dawatit-tammah, was-salatil-qa-imah, ati muhammadan al-wasilata wal-fadilah, wabathhu maqaman mahmudan alladhi waadtah
azkar.translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the means and virtue, and raise him to the Praiseworthy Station which You have promised him.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma salli ala muhammadin wa ala ali muhammad
azkar.translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ahillahu alayna bil-yumni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-islam, rabbi wa rabbuk Allah
azkar.translation: O Allah, let this moon appear over us with blessing and faith, safety and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.

azkar.text: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ
azkar.transliteration: Allahu akbar, allahumma ahillahu alayna bil-amni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-islam
azkar.translation: Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, let this moon appear over us with security and faith, safety and Islam.

azkar.text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
azkar.transliteration: al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi kasani hadhath-thawba wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
azkar.translation: All praise is due to Allah who clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or strength from me.

azkar.text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي مَا أُوَارِي بِهِ عَوْرَتِي وَأَتَجَمَّلُ بِهِ فِي حَيَاتِي
azkar.transliteration: al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi kasani ma uwari bihi awrati wa atajammalu bihi fi hayati
azkar.translation: All praise is due to Allah who clothed me with what covers my private parts and with which I beautify myself in my life.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهُ وَخَيْرَ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma lakal-hamd, anta kasawtanih, asaluka khayrahu wa khayra ma suniya lah, wa audhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suniya lah
azkar.translation: O Allah, all praise is for You. You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its goodness and the goodness for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.
